name: Figure 03
description: Figure AI's third-generation humanoid, redesigned with soft washable textiles, upgraded palm cameras and tactile hands, and a faster-charging battery. Currently deployed in enterprise pilots, including BMW's Spartanburg plant, running on Figure's Helix vision-language-action model.
sourcing: Specs sourced from Figure AI's own product and announcement pages (figure.ai/figure, figure.ai/news/introducing-figure-03, figure.ai/news/f-03-battery-development, figure.ai/news/f-03-at-bmw), cross-checked against Wikipedia and TechRadar as of September 2026. Figure's own page lists height as 5'8", while some press coverage cites 5'6" — both are noted above. Onboard compute/chip is not publicly disclosed by Figure. robotindex does not sell this product.

pricing.summary: Figure 03 has no public price and is **not sold to consumers** — it's deployed only through enterprise/industrial agreements such as BMW's. CEO Brett Adcock has floated a rough **~$600/month** home-leasing concept for late 2026, but Figure has given no confirmed consumer price or delivery timeline.

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: Figure 03 doubles vision frame rate, quarters latency, and widens each camera's field of view 60%. Each hand has an embedded palm camera and fingertip tactile sensors sensing forces as low as 3 grams, with softer adaptive fingertips for grasping. The exterior uses soft, washable textiles. Its battery is the first humanoid pack certified to UN38.3 and UL2271.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: Figure 03 units are already deployed at BMW Group's Spartanburg, SC plant (arrived June 2026), performing parts sequencing, picking, and heavy cart-pulling using Figure's Helix 02 vision-language-action model — a real production deployment, not just an announcement. Figure has stated capacity of up to 12,000 units/year, but production and deployment figures beyond BMW have not been independently verified.

firmwareCommunity.note: Figure 03 has not released a public SDK, firmware repo, or developer API. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
